subject.title: feat(channels): core-owned durable ingress drain — one turn-adoption lifecycle, Telegram first

question: Should the narrowed `createChannelIngressDrain`/`turnAdoptionLifecycle` surface become a permanent public Plugin SDK and plugin-runtime contract in this PR?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but approving a new permanent plugin API and its compatibility burden requires repository ownership intent; tests and live proof cannot decide that contract boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow seam
options.body: Confirm the current generic factory, lifecycle binding, selected constants, types, and runtime opener as the supported contract after resolving conflicts and rerunning exact-head gates.

options.title: Keep it bundled-only
options.body: Rework the boundary to a bundled-plugin facade and defer public SDK exports until another independently proven channel consumer exists.

options.title: Pause for the next adapter
options.body: Hold this PR until the WhatsApp follow-up provides a second live consumer and validates the proposed contract under another transport.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow seam
recommendation.body: Confirm the current generic factory, lifecycle binding, selected constants, types, and runtime opener as the supported contract after resolving conflicts and rerunning exact-head gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the Plugin SDK surface-reduction and shared-channel boundary immediately affected by this decision.
